# The sitemap is generated by the Workers API (see workers/src/routes/sitemap.ts),
# not the frontend. Pointing this at the frontend domain would hit the SPA
# catch-all in _redirects and return index.html instead of XML. Point this at
# your deployed API's public domain -- ideally a same-site subdomain such as
# https://api.icebrim.com/sitemap.xml (see DEPLOYMENT.md §4 / wrangler.toml
# WORKER_PUBLIC_URL) once the custom domain from FIX-002 is connected.
Sitemap: https://api.icebrim.com/sitemap.xml
